messages:
anna: :wave: heads up — planning a coordinated rollout to split the async SDKs out from the legacy sync packages and mark the sync client as deprecated. target change window: Thu 03:00 UTC. canary: Tue 22:00 UTC. plan: 1) publish py async prerelease to testpypi 2) publish ts alpha to npm with dist-tag 'canary' 3) run canary integration tests 4) publish final and push deprecation docs. any blockers? @jess @mike

mike: QA - need the migration guide published before canary. also seeing flaky failures on streaming integration in local runs. i can freeze infra for the canary but need an ETA on the fix.

jess: release eng - i can handle publishing steps. we'd like to stage with dist-tags and avoid moving 'latest' until post-canary. can we support customer pinning for heavy clients during rollout?

sam: devex - for python use a prerelease like redwood-async==2.0.0a1 and upload to testpypi first. give customers a compat table in README and a short sync->async migration snippet. also add an env var opt-in pin: REDWOOD_PIN_SYNC=true we can toggle at our side.

deploy-bot: publish pipeline queued: job #5842. steps: build wheels, run smoke, upload to testpypi/npm next. starting build...

ci-bot: smoke tests (job #5842) -> FAILED: streaming integration timeout (502). snippet: ```Traceback (most recent call last): ... ConnectionResetError: [Errno 104] Connection reset by peer```

mike: reproducing locally now. looks like kv-cache eviction race on long-lived streams. marking as blocker for canary.

jess: hold publish. cancelling canary run. we should delay the change window to Thu 11:00 UTC to allow time for fix & extra QA.

sams: (typo in previous) — updated: also add a brief note for support on how to pin customers to 1.9.x (we'll keep a pinned branch & wheel uploads).

anna: ok — hold. i'll update the release notes draft to include deprecation timeline: 'redwood-sync-client' EOL 2026-06-01 and migration steps (short code diff + link to full guide).

sam: suggestion: ship a small compat shim in 2.0 that logs a deprecation warning for sync API calls and points to migration guide. that reduces churn for big customers.

jess: canceled job #5842 (by jess) :white_check_mark: will re-run once fix merges.

anna: mike, estimate for fix?

mike: i have a patch for kv-cache guardrail, running unit + integration locally. should have PR up in ~4h, full QA by tomorrow morning.

jess: plan after fix: we'll run canary to testpypi/npm: commands: ```pip install --index-url https://test.pypi.org/simple redwood-async==2.0.0a1``` and ```npm dist-tag add @redwood/async-client@2.0.0-alpha canary``` keep 'latest' untouched.

ci-bot: nightly canary integration run scheduled once artifacts uploaded.

mike: QA will run full suite on canary Wed; if >2 critical failures => rollback and revert any published artifacts.

deploy-bot: publish job #5860 started (after fixes): build -> smoke -> upload to test registries -> integration. artifacts: redwood_async-2.0.0a1-py3-none-any.whl, @redwood/async-client@2.0.0-alpha

ci-bot: canary integration run -> PASS (integration+smoke).

deploy-bot: publish success to testpypi/npm; npm dist-tag 'canary' set; 'latest' unchanged.

jess: after canary pass: schedule final publish in Thu 11:00 UTC change window. final publish steps: bump to 2.0.0, twine upload to pypi, npm publish + optionally move dist-tag. i'll keep a step to pin heavy customers to 1.9.x and notify success.

anna: added deprecation PR draft for docs and a short customer comms draft. please review: link.internal/docs/pr/123 (placeholder).

sam: add migration snippets: from sync: ```client = SyncClient() -> new: client = AsyncClient(); await client.start()``` and include quick fixes for common blocking patterns.

jess: post-publish checklist: create release notes, open support playbook, email cs draft to be approved. i'll also create a rollback runbook in case npm/pypi publish needs revert.

mike: QA :thumbsup: i'll run extended tests during the Wed canary window.

anna: thanks everyone — unless anyone objects i'll send calendar invite for Thu 11:00 UTC and mark canary Tue 22:00 UTC (re-run if needed). :rocket:

jess: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: job #5860 completed and artifacts retained for 7 days.

anna: closing for now — will update thread when calendar + release notes are final.
